question: Which of our commercial lending clients also have more than $5 million of capital-markets credit exposure, and what is each one's combined exposure?
answer:
**Answer:** 14 commercial lending clients have more than $5M of capital-markets credit exposure as of 2026-09-30. Together they have **$546.1M combined exposure**: $301.2M capital markets plus $244.9M lending commitments. If lending is counted as drawn balances only, the combined total is $449.6M.

| # | Client (CIF) | Segment | Capital-markets exposure | Lending commitment (drawn) | **Combined** | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Harrowgate Health Co (42498) | MM | $37.16M | $29.20M ($17.12M) | **$66.36M** | Includes $7.7M standby letter of credit (SBLC) |
| 2 | Pinecrest Valley Group LLC (41850) | MM | $38.83M | $20.45M ($17.19M) | **$59.28M** | ⚠ Active loans rated 7 (Special Mention); one earlier loan charged off |
| 3 | Kestrel Automation Systems LLC (41022) | LC | $6.50M | $45.00M ($31.67M) | **$51.50M** | |
| 4 | Pinecrest Properties Inc (42036) | MM | $32.04M | $13.85M ($11.14M) | **$45.89M** | |
| 5 | Yarrowby Industries LLC (41642) | LC | $33.32M | $7.30M ($4.29M) | **$40.62M** | Rated 6 (Watch) |
| 6 | Foxmere Valley Holdings LLC (42083) | MM | $31.63M | $8.10M ($7.12M) | **$39.73M** | |
| 7 | Calloway Health Inc (42648) | MM | $24.27M | $14.25M ($6.64M) | **$38.52M** | |
| 8 | Ravensholm Systems Inc (41539) | LC | $33.62M | $2.60M ($1.75M) | **$36.22M** | Rated 6 (Watch) |
| 9 | Ivorline Services Inc (41974) | MM | $7.15M | $24.10M ($9.41M) | **$31.25M** | Includes $13.7M SBLC |
| 10 | Blackridge Supply LLC (42657) | MM | $12.14M | $17.65M ($0) | **$29.79M** | Lending is only an undrawn SBLC |
| 11 | Dunmore Energy Inc (41168) | LC | $6.14M | $23.10M ($14.96M) | **$29.24M** | |
| 12 | Pinecrest Distribution LLC (42037) | MM | $10.77M | $16.25M ($12.98M) | **$27.02M** | |
| 13 | Kingsmere Ridge Group LLC (42233) | MM | $18.44M | $8.40M ($4.06M) | **$26.84M** | ⚠ Equipment loan rated 7 (Special Mention); one earlier loan charged off |
| 14 | Hollinsby Engineering Co (42452) | MM | $9.17M | $14.65M ($10.13M) | **$23.82M** | Rated 6 (Watch) |

**Things worth noting:**
- **Earlier losses:** Pinecrest Valley and Kingsmere each have a charged-off equipment loan ($1.68M and $7.81M originally committed). Those loans are left out of the totals above. Both clients still carry over $18M of capital-markets exposure each.
- **Pinecrest names:** Three Pinecrest clients appear (#2, #4, #12), with $132.2M combined. I didn't check whether they belong to one corporate group. All figures are per client, not rolled up by parent company.
- **Excluded from the list:**
  - Six capital-markets counterparties over $5M are not lending clients. Five aren't linked to any client record: four "Fund LP" entities (Moorcroft Global Opportunities $26.4M, Pinecrest Macro $19.1M, Moorcroft Macro $18.0M, Brandvold Macro $15.2M) and Hollinsby Capital Markets LLC ($8.3M).
  - Halvorsen Capital Services LLC ($22.0M) is a client but has no credit facilities.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Capital-markets exposure:** Fabric `dbo.CM_EXPOSURE`, 2026-09-30 snapshot, summed by entity.
  - The measure is current exposure: the positive mark-to-market value (what the client would owe us), with negative values set to zero.
  - It does not include trade face value (notional), potential future exposure or collateral.
  - Each of these clients has one trade. The $5M threshold was tested on this measure.
- **Client link:** Fabric `dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY.CIF_REF` (5 digits) matched to Snowflake `CORE.CLIENT.CIF_NO` (10 digits, zero-padded). The match is one-to-one with no duplicates.
- **Lending clients:** clients with at least one ACTIVE facility in `LENDING.FACILITY`.
- **Lending exposure:** drawn plus undrawn amounts at 2026-09-30 from `LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY`, which equals the current commitment.
  - Standby letters of credit are included; the product table lists them as loans but off-balance-sheet.
  - Paid-off and charged-off facilities are excluded.
  - Risk ratings were decoded with `REF.RISK_RATING`.
- **Assumption:** "Combined exposure" means capital-markets current exposure plus lending commitment. The drawn-only figures are shown in brackets in case you prefer that basis.
- **Not used:** the archive, legacy-hierarchy and sandbox tables.

sql.sql: SELECT SNAP_DT, PRODUCT, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT TRADE_ID) trades, COUNT(DISTINCT ENTITY_ID) ents, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, SUM(MTM_AMT) mtm, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_ce, SUM(CASE WHEN MTM_AMT<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_mtm, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_ce, SUM(CASE WHEN ENTITY_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_ent FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE GROUP BY SNAP_DT, PRODUCT ORDER BY SNAP_DT, PRODUCT

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN MTM_AMT<0 AND CURRENT_EXPOSURE<>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_mtm_nonzero_ce, SUM(CASE WHEN MTM_AMT>=0 AND CURRENT_EXPOSURE<>MTM_AMT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pos_mismatch, MIN(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) mn, MAX(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) mx FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT ENTITY_ID) ents, COUNT(CIF_REF) with_cif, COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_REF) dist_cif, MIN(LEN(CIF_REF)) minlen, MAX(LEN(CIF_REF)) maxlen, SUM(CASE WHEN CIF_REF LIKE '%[^0-9]%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonnumeric, MIN(CIF_REF) mincif, MAX(CIF_REF) maxcif FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY

SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_NO) d, MIN(LENGTH(CIF_NO)) mnl, MAX(LENGTH(CIF_NO)) mxl, MIN(CIF_NO), MAX(CIF_NO), LISTAGG(DISTINCT CLIENT_STATUS, ',') st, LISTAGG(DISTINCT SEGMENT_CD, ',') seg FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT

SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, le.ENTITY_TYP, le.CIF_REF, e.ce, e.trades, e.notional FROM (SELECT ENTITY_ID, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, COUNT(*) trades, SUM(NOTIONAL_AMT) notional FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE WHERE SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' GROUP BY ENTITY_ID HAVING SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) > 5000000) e LEFT JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le ON le.ENTITY_ID=e.ENTITY_ID ORDER BY e.ce DESC

SELECT f.FACILITY_STATUS, f.PRODUCT_CD, p.PRODUCT_FAMILY, COUNT(*) n, SUM(COMMIT_AMT) c, COUNT(PAYOFF_DT) po, COUNT(CHGOFF_DT) co FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.REF.PRODUCT p ON p.PRODUCT_CD=f.PRODUCT_CD GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT CIF_NO, CLIENT_NM, SEGMENT_CD FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT WHERE CLIENT_NM ILIKE '%Fund%' OR CLIENT_NM ILIKE '%Capital Markets%' OR CLIENT_NM ILIKE 'Moorcroft%' OR CLIENT_NM ILIKE 'Brandvold%'

SELECT c.CIF_NO, c.CLIENT_NM, c.SEGMENT_CD, c.CLIENT_STATUS,
 COUNT(DISTINCT f.FACILITY_ID) n_fac_all,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN f.FACILITY_ID END) n_active,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' AND b.FACILITY_ID IS NOT NULL THEN f.FACILITY_ID END) n_active_w_bal,
 LISTAGG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN f.PRODUCT_CD END, ',') prods,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN f.COMMIT_AMT END) commit_active,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN b.DRAWN_AMT END) drawn,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' THEN b.UNDRAWN_AMT END) undrawn,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.FACILITY_STATUS='ACTIVE' AND f.PRODUCT_CD='SBLC' THEN b.DRAWN_AMT+b.UNDRAWN_AMT END) sblc_amt,
 MAX(f.RISK_RATING) worst_rr, MAX(b.DPD) max_dpd
FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c
LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.CIF_NO=c.CIF_NO
LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
WHERE c.CIF_NO IN ('0000041850','0000042498','0000041539','0000041642','0000042036','0000042083','0000042648','0000041002','0000042233','0000042657','0000042037','0000042452','0000041974','0000041022','0000041168')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.CIF_NO, f.FACILITY_ID, f.PRODUCT_CD, f.FACILITY_STATUS, f.COMMIT_AMT, f.RISK_RATING, b.DRAWN_AMT, b.DPD, b.ACCRUAL_STAT FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' WHERE f.CIF_NO IN ('0000041850','0000042233') ORDER BY 1,2
